snippet.title: Gata Guressi • Steam Demo Announcement
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3962430/Gata_Guressi/

Gata Guressi is a sci-fi translation game where you learn to communicate with the people of the Hierre system by translating their languages and understanding their cultures. Build your knowledge of Hierre's history, culture, and planets, then put it to use to solve your brother's mysterious disappearance.
